title: Where Can a Decision Model Diagnose HVAC Faults? Reasoning Demand, Physical Representation, and Robustness Under Shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.09937v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Artificial intelligence supports building operations in several forms, each with its own barrier. Expert rules must be tuned for every system, supervised models need labeled data that buildings rarely record, and language models return free text that requires human-in-the-loop checking, since their stated confidence is unreliable. A newer kind of pretrained model, here called a decision model, returns a probability for every allowed answer, so one model could serve many decisions without training. This study answers three open questions for fault diagnosis in heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems: which decisions such a model can make, what input it needs, and whether its probabilities hold when conditions change. On 128 fault days from four public datasets of real equipment, faults are graded by the reasoning their diagnosis demands, with data given raw, as physical features, or with Brick topology. translated_title: 决策模型能在何处诊断暖通空调故障？推理需求、物理表征与分布偏移下的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 人工智能以多种形式支持建筑运营，而每种形式都存在自身的障碍。专家规则必须针对每个系统进行调校，监督模型需要建筑中很少记录的标注数据，语言模型返回的自由文本则需人工在环核查，因其声称的置信度并不可靠。一类较新的预训练模型，本文称之为决策模型，会为每个允许的答案返回一个概率，因此单个模型无需训练即可服务于多种决策。本研究回答了暖通空调系统故障诊断的三个开放问题：这类模型能做出哪些决策、它需要什么样的输入，以及当条件发生变化时其概率输出是否依然可靠。研究基于来自四个真实设备公开数据集的128个故障日，按照诊断所需推理的复杂程度对故障进行分级，并以三种方式提供数据：原始数据、物理特征以及附带Brick拓扑结构的信息。决策模型J
tldr: 该研究系统评估了免训练的预训练决策模型在暖通空调故障诊断中的能力边界，考察了不同物理表征输入下按推理需求分级的诊断表现及其在条件偏移时概率输出的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates the capability boundaries of a training-free pretrained decision model for HVAC fault diagnosis, examining its graded performance under different physical input representations and the robustness of its probability outputs under condition shift.
